title: Ensure 'Audit insecure guest logon' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Workstation\Audit insecure guest logon to 'Enabled'
reason: Insecure guest logons can be used by file servers to allow unauthenticated access to shared folders.

title: Ensure 'Audit server does not support encryption' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Workstation\Audit server does not support encryption to 'Enabled'
reason: Organizations should be aware of all unencrypted SMB traffic in their environment.

title: Ensure 'Audit server does not support signing' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Workstation\Audit server does not support signing to 'Enabled'
reason: Older SMB protocols that do not use signing can make an environment susceptible to many types of attacks.

title: Ensure 'Enable insecure guest logons' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Workstation\Enable insecure guest logons to 'Disabled'
reason: Insecure guest logons are used by file servers to allow unauthenticated access to shared folders.

title: Ensure 'Enable remote mailslots' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Workstation\Enable remote mailslots to 'Disabled'
reason: Remote mailslots is a legacy protocol that uses SMBv1 to function and is linked to known vulnerabilities.

title: Ensure 'Mandate the minimum version of SMB' is set to 'Enabled: 3.1.1'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Workstation\Mandate the minimum version of SMB to 'Enabled: 3.1.1'
reason: SMBv1 is no longer enabled by default due to its security risks, and although SMBv2 is more robust than v1, it does not support encryption like its successor.

title: Ensure 'Require Encryption' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\Lanman Workstation\Require Encryption to 'Enabled'
reason: SMBv3 supports encryption to protect traffic, whereas earlier versions do not.
